Dolos phase-1 validations - Milestone #2 report

We are pleased to announce the successful completion of Milestone #2 for the Dolos phase-1 validations Catalyst project, covering the Shelley era with its two hard forks, namely Allegra and Mary, which we here call the ShelleyMA era. We are proud of the rapid progress made during Milestone #2, and are sincerely excited about opening up this working prototype of Dolos for feedback from the community.
Milestone goals and proofs of completion
・Document Findings and Rule Definition: comprehensive documentation outlining findings and defining the required ledger rules for the ShelleyMA era can be found here:https://github.com/txpipe/pallas/tree/main/pallas-applying/docs/shelleyMA-validation-rules.md
